panels.title: Retention Cohort Heatmap
panels.description: Cohort = users whose first VIEW_STARTED was on that date. Values = % of cohort with any event N days later.

targets.rawSql: WITH first_view AS (SELECT user_id, min(toDate(timestamp)) AS cohort_date FROM cinema.movie_events WHERE event_type = 'VIEW_STARTED' GROUP BY user_id), cohort_sizes AS (SELECT cohort_date, uniqExact(user_id) AS cohort_size FROM first_view GROUP BY cohort_date) SELECT toString(f.cohort_date) AS "Cohort", cs.cohort_size AS "Size", round(100.0 * uniqExactIf(f.user_id, toDate(e.timestamp) = f.cohort_date) / cs.cohort_size, 1) AS "Day 0", round(100.0 * uniqExactIf(f.user_id, toDate(e.timestamp) = f.cohort_date + 1) / cs.cohort_size, 1) AS "Day 1", round(100.0 * uniqExactIf(f.user_id, toDate(e.timestamp) = f.cohort_date + 2) / cs.cohort_size, 1) AS "Day 2", round(100.0 * uniqExactIf(f.user_id, toDate(e.timestamp) = f.cohort_date + 3) / cs.cohort_size, 1) AS "Day 3", round(100.0 * uniqExactIf(f.user_id, toDate(e.timestamp) = f.cohort_date + 4) / cs.cohort_size, 1) AS "Day 4", round(100.0 * uniqExactIf(f.user_id, toDate(e.timestamp) = f.cohort_date + 5) / cs.cohort_size, 1) AS "Day 5", round(100.0 * uniqExactIf(f.user_id, toDate(e.timestamp) = f.cohort_date + 6) / cs.cohort_size, 1) AS "Day 6", round(100.0 * uniqExactIf(f.user_id, toDate(e.timestamp) = f.cohort_date + 7) / cs.cohort_size, 1) AS "Day 7" FROM first_view f JOIN cinema.movie_events e ON f.user_id = e.user_id JOIN cohort_sizes cs ON f.cohort_date = cs.cohort_date GROUP BY f.cohort_date, cs.cohort_size ORDER BY f.cohort_date DESC LIMIT 30
SELECT toStartOfDay(toDateTime(date)) AS time, toUInt64(metric_value) AS DAU FROM cinema.agg_daily_metrics FINAL WHERE metric_name = 'dau' ORDER BY date

panels.title: View Conversion Rate
panels.description: Percentage of VIEW_STARTED sessions that result in VIEW_FINISHED

targets.rawSql: SELECT toStartOfDay(toDateTime(date)) AS time, round(metric_value * 100, 2) AS "Conversion %" FROM cinema.agg_daily_metrics FINAL WHERE metric_name = 'conversion_rate' ORDER BY date
SELECT movie_id, toUInt64(view_count) AS Views FROM cinema.agg_top_movies FINAL WHERE date = (SELECT max(date) FROM cinema.agg_top_movies FINAL) ORDER BY rank ASC
